text:
pete-ops: Quick heads-up: Orion-Titan T120 preview pools opening in lagos-2 and warsaw-1 on 2026-10-12 06:00 UTC. This is a limited validation window for non-prod workloads only. Please don’t migrate production yet.

hana-eng: Nice. Specs / mem / latency vs L80?

pete-ops: T120 quick specs: 144GB VRAM, NVSwitch++ fabric, DPX sparsity engines, optimized long-seq tensor paths. Early internal microbench: FP16 throughput ~2.3x L80 on long contexts; short-context latency ~1.1x L80. Preliminary numbers — full perf pack will be posted after wave 1.

ops-bot: System notice: pools/orion-t120 labeled "preview-rotational". Default warm-window = 50m. Preemptible cap = 15% of pool. Placement priority = reserved contracts > committed buckets > warm reservations > ad-hoc. Preview pools do not honor priority guarantees. See policy: https://intranet.redwood/policies/dedicated-preview (internal).

hana-eng: Any reservation semantic gotchas?

pete-ops: A few notes: 1) --priority high will not force placement in preview pools, 2) include --meta "experiment=orion-titan-oct2026" for billing/tracking, 3) system will auto-apply label "no_customer_data" to preview reservations.

mika-sre: Oncall/runbook: T120 racks use redundant cooling cluster C3. If you see coolant or PSU alarms tag @mika-sre and escalate to #eng-oncall. Runbook: https://intranet.redwood/runbooks/orion-t120 (internal).

julie-product: Billing / chargeback tag? We want clean tracking for partner tests.

pete-ops: Use charge tag: orion-preview-oct2026 in reservation metadata. Console filter will be added by EOD.

omar-ps: Legal / compliance reminder: do NOT place regulated customer data on preview pools until clearance. We'll publish a short partner checklist tomorrow.

pete-ops: Reservation CLI example (copy/paste):
```
# reserve 1 GPU in orion-t120 pool in lagos-2 for 75 minutes starting 2026-10-12T06:00Z
rdrctl reserve --pool orion-t120 --region lagos-2 --count 1 --start 2026-10-12T06:00Z --duration 75m --meta "charge=orion-preview-oct2026,experiment=orion-titan-oct2026"
```

hana-eng: grabbing one for long-seq generator smoke now.

ops-bot: Reservation confirmed (id: 55901) for hana-eng — pool: orion-t120, region: lagos-2, start: 2026-10-12T06:00Z, duration: 75m.

mika-sre: Firmware and software notes: T120 systems pinned to firmware v1.0.0-preview and runtime bundle rdx-2026.10. Do not patch without coordination.

pete-ops: Policy change (effective immediately for preview pools): preview reservations will automatically include the "no_customer_data" guard label; attempts to override will be blocked. If you need an exemption for internal compliance-approved tests, open a ticket with tag "orion-t120-exempt". Abuse will be audited.

julie-product: We'll enable a console health card for pools/orion-t120 by tomorrow morning that shows utilization, temperature, and active preview reservations.

hana-eng: saw minor p99 variance vs devbench in first run, posting traces to #eng-runtime and will attach reservation id.

pete-ops: Thanks — please open tickets for infra anomalies with label "orion-t120-preview" and tag @mika-sre. We'll pause the window if we see systemic issues. :eyes:
